entries.zh: 畜生；狗东西（骂人语）；诅咒
entries.en: beast; dog (a term of abuse); curse
entries.notes: L『genos』词形可疑（疑为 genio 之讹）；『bestia/maldicion』与 H『禽狗人』、M 逐字对音相合，R 空。

entries.en: to pursue; to persecute; to press hard
to persecute many; to press and injure
entries.notes: R 栏作西文『mucho』而非官话对音；H『繫』与 M quîn 对应存疑（疑为『緊』）。

entries.zh: 坚持；有恒；壮志（坚定志向）
机敏；一点就透（点头便知机）
entries.en: sharp-witted; quick to catch on (understands at a nod)
entries.notes: L『Perspical/apun-fandole』为 perspicaz、apuntándole 之讹省；H 末字『稅』当为『機』之讹，与 M 末音节 quy 相应。
L 仅存 perguntar（询问）词头，H 栏实为西文残片『per puntar.』，M/R 皆空，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 行贿；以贿赂打点（以求脱身）
entries.en: to bribe; to suborn (so as to be released)
entries.notes: H『賄』与 M iùbou（賄賂）相合，R 栏西文『dar soborno』明指行贿；L『Persuadis』为块内字母序词头。

entries.en: to persuade; to exhort; to advise
to move (someone); to win over by moving them
entries.notes: H 仅『動』一字，M 后二音节 lan hoi 未详，M 首音节音标污损（T99）。
R 栏音写残乱（kaer teal m tor teo）难复原；H『宛轉』即委婉。

entries.en: to persuade with soft words; to coax
to persuade; Chinese gloss 'dang ren huo' unclear
entries.notes: H 三字与 M tong lang huei 对音整齐，但与西语 persuadir 语义不合，疑误抄或别有所指。

entries.en: to belong to; to concern; to pertain
to concern; to have to do with; to be involved
it is my affair; it concerns me
it is your affair; it concerns you

entries.zh: 有利害相干；干求（求取利益）
entries.en: to have an interest in; to solicit (for gain)
entries.notes: 『por interés』语义费解，H/M『干求』偏向求取义，与 pertenecer 本义有张力。

entries.en: it belongs to the house; house, dwelling
entries.notes: L 栏残乱（疑为『pertenece a la casa』），H/M 明确作『厝宅』，M 两音节音标皆污损（T99）。
